1.english_reference: Jotham [ was ] twenty and five years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יוֹתָ֣ם בְּ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Εἴκοσι πέντε ἐτῶν Ἰωαθὰμ ἐν τῷ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Vigínti quinque annórum erat Ióatham cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Jotham [ was ] twenty and five years old when he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ δέκα ἓξ ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et sédecim annis regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .

1.english_reference: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Jerushah , the daughter of Zadok

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖ה בַּת צָדֽוֹק
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἰερουσσὰ θυγάτηρ Σαδώρ .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Iérusa fília Sadoc .
traditions.KJV: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Jerushah , the daughter of Zadok .

2.english_reference: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Uzziah did

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ יָּשָׁ֜ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה כְּ כֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐποίησεν Ὀζείας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque quod rectum erat coram Dómino , iuxta ómnia quæ fécerat Ozías pater suus ,
traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Uzziah did :

2.english_reference: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD

traditions.WLC: ו רַ֕ק לֹא בָ֖א אֶל הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν ναὸν Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: excépto quod non est ingréssus templum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD .

2.english_reference: And the people did yet corruptly

traditions.KJV: And the people did yet corruptly .

3.english_reference: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה הָ עֶלְי֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν πύλην οἴκου Κυρίου τὴν ὑψηλήν ,
traditions.VUL: Ipse ædificávit portam domus Dómini excélsam ,
traditions.KJV: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD ,

3.english_reference: and on the wall of Ophel he built much

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ חוֹמַ֥ת הָ עֹ֛פֶל בָּנָ֖ה לָ רֹֽב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τείχει αὐτοῦ Ὄπλα ᾠκοδόμησεν πολλά ·
traditions.VUL: et in muro Ophel multa constrúxit .
traditions.KJV: and on the wall of Ophel he built much .

4.english_reference: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah

traditions.WLC: וְ עָרִ֥ים בָּנָ֖ה בְּ הַר יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πόλεις ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐν ὄρει Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: Urbes quoque ædificávit in móntibus Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah ,

4.english_reference: and in the forests he built castles and towers

traditions.WLC: וּ בֶ חֳרָשִׁ֣ים בָּנָ֔ה בִּֽירָנִיּ֖וֹת וּ מִגְדָּלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τοῖς δρυμοῖς καὶ οἰκήσεις καὶ πύργους .
traditions.VUL: et in sáltibus castélla et turres .
traditions.KJV: and in the forests he built castles and towers .

5.english_reference: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ הוּא נִלְחַ֞ם עִם מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן֮ וַ יֶּחֱזַ֣ק עֲלֵי הֶם֒
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ἐμαχέσατο πρὸς βασιλέα υἱῶν Ἀμμὼν καὶ κατίσχυσεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: Ipse pugnávit contra regem filiórum Ammon , et vicit eos ,
traditions.KJV: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them .

5.english_reference: And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנוּ ל֨ וֹ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֜וֹן בַּ שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ הִ֗יא מֵאָה֙ כִּכַּר כֶּ֔סֶף וַ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים כֹּרִים֙ חִטִּ֔ים וּ שְׂעוֹרִ֖ים עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐδίδουν αὐτῷ κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτὸν ἑκατὸν τάλαντα ἀργυρίου καὶ δέκα χιλιάδας κόρων πυροῦ καὶ κριθῶν δέκα χιλιάδας ·
traditions.VUL: dederúntque ei fílii Ammon in témpore illo centum talénta argénti , et decem míllia coros trítici , ac tótidem coros hórdei :
traditions.KJV: And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley .

5.english_reference: So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third

traditions.WLC: זֹ֗את הֵשִׁ֤יבוּ ל וֹ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ בַ שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ שֵּׁנִ֖ית וְ הַ שְּׁלִשִֽׁית
traditions.LXX: ταῦτα ἔφερεν αὐτῷ βασιλεὺς Ἀμμὼν κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτὸν ἐν τῷ πρώτῳ ἔτει καὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ καὶ τῷ τρίτῳ .
traditions.VUL: hæc ei præbuérunt fílii Ammon in anno secúndo et tértio .
traditions.KJV: So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .

6.english_reference: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק יוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֚י הֵכִ֣ין דְּרָכָ֔י ו לִ פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατίσχυσεν Ἰωαθάμ , ὅτι ἡτοίμασεν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ ἔναντι Κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Corroboratúsque est Ióatham , eo quod direxísset vias suas coram Dómino Deo suo .
traditions.KJV: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God .

7.english_reference: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham , and all his wars , and his ways , lo , they [ are ] written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah

traditions.WLC: וְ יֶתֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יוֹתָ֔ם וְ כָל מִלְחֲמֹתָ֖י ו וּ דְרָכָ֑י ו הִנָּ֣ ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִ יהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ λόγοι Ἰωαθὰμ καὶ ὁ πόλεμος καὶ αἱ πράξεις αὐτοῦ , ἰδοὺ γεγραμμένοι ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ βασιλέων Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: Réliqua autem sermónum Ióatham , et omnes pugnæ eius , et ópera , scripta sunt in Libro regum Israel et Iuda .
traditions.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham , and all his wars , and his ways , lo , they [ are ] written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .

8.english_reference: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְ חָמֵ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה הָיָ֣ה בְ מָלְכ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: Vigínti quinque annórum erat cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign ,

8.english_reference: and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.VUL: et sédecim annis regnávit in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .

9.english_reference: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י ו וַ יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖ וֹ בְּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ἰωαθὰμ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ , καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: Dormivítque Ióatham cum pátribus suis , et sepeliérunt eum in civitáte David :
traditions.KJV: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David :

9.english_reference: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖ וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀχὰς υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾽ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et regnávit Achaz fílius eius pro eo .
traditions.KJV: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
